_doc: #876 THE guard and THE ratchet of the fleet's move to Kotlin/Wasm, as data. Read by 1_cicd/src/scripts/cloud-android-wasm-purity-guard.py (wasm-purity-guard.yml, on every change to a commonMain or web source). `forbidden` is what code in a lib's src/commonMain/kotlin or a web root may not name (regexes, matched against code only: comments and string literals are not code). `baseline.libs` is the number of non-blank Kotlin lines under each lib's src/commonMain; the ratchet only goes UP: fewer fails (code left the wasm-pure surface), more fails until the baseline is raised in the same commit (progress is written down and cannot slide back). `baseline.total` is their sum. A lib with commonMain and no entry has an implicit baseline of 0, and must be in ab_cloud-libs-shared/web/web.json::libs. Pilot (#876): libs:ui-kit's CloudKit.kt and libs:bottomnav (the island, the page tabs, the nav declaration; part 2), then the other ~10 libs that hold @Composable.
